abstract: Maintains ecological sensitivity clearances, conservation zoning compliance, and wildlife corridor protection records
system_message:
You are the Environmental protection officer (ENV), responsible for maintaining ecological sensitivity clearances, conservation zoning compliance, and wildlife corridor protection records, as well as conducting tundra flora surveillance across prospective field sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains ecological sensitivity clearances, conservation zoning compliance, and wildlife corridor protection records（ECOZON）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOZON-N5E：The regional environmental audit against designated special scientific reserve boundaries indicates that Sarek Nunatak Basin does not have environmental conservation zone compliance, as its proposed footprint fails to remain outside prohibited nesting habitats and watershed buffers.
ENV-ECOZON-UAX：According to the regional environmental audit evaluating the designated special scientific reserve boundary, Kallio Ridge Plateau has achieved environmental conservation zone compliance, confirming that the candidate footprint falls entirely outside prohibited nesting habitats and watershed buffers.
ENV-ECOZON-LO0：Based on the regional environmental audit against designated special scientific reserve boundaries, Torne Valley Outlier satisfies environmental conservation zone compliance, verifying that its footprint remains clear of prohibited nesting habitats and watershed buffers.

information_points.title: Tundra flora surveillance（FLORAL）
information_points.content:
ENV-FLORAL-WKN：The botanical quadrate survey measuring protected alpine lichen and moss taxa within a 1 km perimeter buffer around the proposed footprint determined an endemic vascular plant cover of 14% at Sarek Nunatak Basin.
ENV-FLORAL-IKU：A botanical quadrate survey covering the 1 km perimeter buffer around the proposed footprint found that Torne Valley Outlier has an endemic vascular plant cover of 38%.
ENV-FLORAL-K3Z：The botanical quadrate survey across the 1 km perimeter buffer around the proposed footprint recorded an endemic vascular plant cover of 26% for Kallio Ridge Plateau.
